liquefaction.title: Liquefaction
liquefaction.description: Liquefaction triggering from SPT and CPT data (Boulanger & Idriss 2014, Youd et al. 2001), factor of safety and LPI.
liquefaction.analysis.title: Liquefaction analysis
liquefaction.analysis.subtitle: Choose the soil profile and enter the analysis settings. a_max and Mw are taken from the project site data only when it has them; you must enter every other value.
liquefaction.profile.label: Soil profile
liquefaction.profile.none: The project has no soil profile. Create a profile in the soil module first.
liquefaction.help.default_fc: Fines content used for SPT records without a lab sample.
liquefaction.help.gwt_seismic: Overrides the seismic groundwater depth of the profile.
liquefaction.error.number_invalid: {field}: enter a valid number or leave it empty.
liquefaction.error.profile_missing: The selected soil profile no longer exists. Reload the profiles and pick one.
liquefaction.error.no_soil_source: The project has no active soil profile. Create or activate a profile in the soil module, then run again.
liquefaction.results.title: Results
liquefaction.results.no_job: No analysis to show. Run the analysis first.
liquefaction.results.unavailable: The result of this analysis is not available (it may have expired or the server restarted). Run the analysis again.
liquefaction.results.stale: This result is outdated: the soil profile or investigation data changed after the analysis. Run the analysis again.
liquefaction.results.cancelled: The analysis was cancelled; there is no result.
liquefaction.results.warnings_scope: Warnings apply to the whole sounding; no depth-specific mapping is provided.
liquefaction.warning.spt_iteration_not_c: (N1)60cs iteration did not converge at {count} point(s).
liquefaction.warning.spt_refusal_lower_b: Refusal blow counts are lower bounds; their FS is conservative.
liquefaction.warning.ic_undefined: I_c is undefined at {count} point(s) (net q_c ≤ 0, f_s ≤ 0 or invalid stress); marked invalid.
liquefaction.warning.fc_from_ic: Fines content (FC) estimated from I_c with C_FC = {c_fc}.
liquefaction.warning.cpt_iteration_not_c: q_c1Ncs iteration did not converge at {count} point(s).
liquefaction.warning.simplified_depth: Points below {depth} m: the simplified procedure is less reliable.
liquefaction.warning.default_fc: Default FC = {fc}% used at depth(s) {depths} m (no laboratory FC).
liquefaction.warning.msf_andrus_stokoe_h: Youd 2001 recommends the Idriss MSF for M > 7.5; the selected Andrus-Stokoe MSF is lower there, so the result is more conservative.
liquefaction.results.mock_note: These results are sample (mock) data, not an actual calculation.
